title: Physical Superintelligence Announces Solutions to 5 Quantum Information Theory Problems
summary:
The research firm Physical Superintelligence released its first series of scientific papers focusing on the field of quantum information theory today. The company announced that the work provides solutions to five long-standing open problems, including formal proofs for each of the results.

The work was produced by a team that includes researchers Ning Bao, Jim Halverson, Ian MacCormack, and Adam Levine. The team stated that the development process involved eliciting results over a wide range of timescales and polishing the final papers for publication.
